purpose: Timestamped, flushed evidence that the game reached a real interactive main menu and that a save actually loaded, for audit/launch_verify.py. Existing plug-in log lines lie: on both hung launches of 2026-08-31, CommunityShaders' InitializeMenuIcons and SkyParkour's log fired at about T+56s on a game that never became playable, so the harness needs the game's own UI and SKSE messaging events instead.

commonLibSSE.pinEnforced: CMake fails unless COMMONLIB_SSE_FOLDER is a git checkout at that exact revision; override requires -DLAUNCHPROBE_ALLOW_UNPINNED_COMMONLIB=ON

toolchain.notes: Mirrors the proven ConsoleUtilSSE-NG-1.7.104 setup read out of its build/release/CMakeCache.txt. Built at BelowNormal process priority.

build.tests: none - no test suite; this is a single-translation-unit plug-in

behavior.logPathResolution: SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Documents) + 'My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE'. Deliberately not SKSE::log::log_directory(), which picks between the Steam and GOG folder names by probing for steam_api64.dll in the working directory.
behavior.lineFormat: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm] +<ms since DLL attach> EVENT key=value key="quoted value"
behavior.flush: fflush after every single line; the harness tails the file live
events: PROBE_OPEN, DLL_ATTACH, PLUGIN_LOAD, CONFIG, LISTENER_REGISTERED, PROBE_READY

SKSE_MESSAGE name="<kPostLoad|kPostPostLoad|kInputLoaded|kDataLoaded|kNewGame|kPreLoadGame|kPostLoadGame|kSaveGame|kDeleteGame>" (kPostLoadGame carries success=1|0|-1; kPreLoadGame/kSaveGame/kDeleteGame carry save="<name>")
MENU_OPEN / MENU_CLOSE name="<menu>" for every RE::MenuOpenCloseEvent
MAIN_MENU_OPEN with ui_is_menu_open and has_movie_view corroboration; MAIN_MENU_ALREADY_OPEN if the menu beat the sink
AUTOLOAD_ARMED / AUTOLOAD_SETTLED / AUTOLOAD_TASK_RUNNING / AUTOLOAD_CALL / AUTOLOAD_RETURNED / AUTOLOAD_ERROR

environment.SKYRIM_LAUNCH_PROBE_AUTOLOAD: save base name without .ess; unset or empty means the plug-in only logs and never touches the game
environment.SKYRIM_LAUNCH_PROBE_DELAY_MS: settle delay after the main menu opens before the load is queued (default 1500)
environment.SKYRIM_LAUNCH_PROBE_HEARTBEAT_MS: periodic liveness line interval; default 0 = off

behavior.noPopups: The plug-in makes no MessageBox call. CommonLibSSE's inline stl::report_and_error (SKSE/Impl/PCH.h:539) does, and REL/IDDB.cpp reaches it on an Address Library failure, so SKSEPlugin_Load rewrites only LaunchProbe.dll's own user32 IAT entries for MessageBoxA/W to logging stubs. The game's import table and every other plug-in are untouched. That path still calls TerminateProcess afterwards; the difference is a log line instead of a modal that would hang an unattended run.
behavior.mainThreadDispatch: The settle timer runs on a detached std::thread; the load itself is queued through SKSE::GetTaskInterface()->AddTask so BGSSaveLoadManager::Load runs on the main thread.

menuEvent.registration: RE::UI::GetSingleton()->AddEventSink<RE::MenuOpenCloseEvent>(sink) - include/RE/U/UI.h:83,166. BSTEventSource::AddEventSink de-duplicates (include/RE/B/BSTEvent.h:34-56), so the plug-in retries registration at kPostLoad, kPostPostLoad, kInputLoaded and kDataLoaded until RE::UI exists.

saveLoad.verifiedAt: declared include/RE/B/BGSSaveLoadManager.h; defined src/RE/B/BGSSaveLoadManager.cpp:35-38, which forwards to Load_Impl(a_fileName, -1, 0, a_checkForMods) at RELOCATION_ID(34819, 35728)
saveLoad.checkForMods: false, on purpose - the checking overload can raise the game's own missing-content modal, which would hang an unattended harness run

messagingEnum.verifiedAt: include/SKSE/Interfaces.h:276-288 - kPostLoad, kPostPostLoad, kPreLoadGame, kPostLoadGame, kSaveGame, kDeleteGame, kInputLoaded, kNewGame, kDataLoaded

skseGate.name: LaunchProbe
skseGate.author: Ensrick
skseGate.versionIndependenceExMeaning: kVersionIndependentEx_NoStructUse (CommonLibSSE-NG maps StructCompatibility::Independent onto this bit); the AddressLibraryV5 bit is NOT set
skseGate.compatibleVersions: 16 x 1.0.0.0 - the RuntimeCompatibility default array, unused because the address-library flag is set
skseGate.why: The missing AddressLibraryV5 bit is only fatal when the PE TimeDateStamp lands in [520128000, 1748217600); 1788236030 is well past that window, so the plug-in passes on the stamp alone. Byte-for-byte the same gate shape as the already-installed ConsoleUtilSSE 1.7.104 overlay (versionIndependence=1, versionIndependenceEx=1, V5 bit NO, PASS), which is the closest available proxy for SKSE actually accepting it.

verified: Release (RelWithDebInfo) build completes against the exact CommonLibSSE-NG pin 70c1acd, 0 warnings and 0 errors.
The DLL reports file version 1.0.0.0 and exports SKSEPlugin_Load, SKSEPlugin_Query and SKSEPlugin_Version.

It imports only standard Windows/DirectX libraries; MessageBoxA/W come in through USER32 solely as CommonLibSSE's fatal-report path, and the plug-in rewrites those two slots in its own import table at load.
audit/skse_version_data.py returns PASS (version independent) for SKSE on 1.7.104.

Every API used (RE::MainMenu::MENU_NAME, RE::MenuOpenCloseEvent, RE::UI::AddEventSink, RE::BGSSaveLoadManager::Load, the SKSE messaging enum) was read out of the pinned CommonLibSSE-NG headers and sources, not assumed.
notVerified: Nothing has been run in-game. The game was not launched: a real launch is scheduled by the team lead, not by this build.
That SKSE 2.3.1 actually loads the DLL at runtime. The static gate passes and matches an accepted plug-in's shape, but only skse64.log proves loading.
That LaunchProbe.log is created at the expected path, and that the timestamps and line format survive contact with the running game.

That RE::MenuOpenCloseEvent fires for the main menu before or after kDataLoaded on this runtime, and therefore which of the four registration stages actually takes. The already-open poll covers both orderings but has not been observed.
That BGSSaveLoadManager::Load succeeds from the main menu and produces kPreLoadGame/kPostLoadGame. The signature and relocation IDs are verified in source; the runtime behaviour is not.
That the IAT rewrite finds and replaces the MessageBox slots at runtime (the import entries exist in the PE, and the log records POPUP_PATCHED or POPUP_PATCH_SKIPPED either way).
Whether the auto-load path is reachable at all if the Address Library for 1.7.104 is missing, since the CommonLibSSE fatal path terminates the process after logging.

installation.note: Staged only, by instruction. Nothing was installed, enabled, or deployed into the MO2 instance; the profile, modlist, plugins.txt and load order were not touched.
